flags.message: Frozen distribution_count=1 counts the June 10, 2026 distribution of the sealing motion (25M91) for the 6/25/2026 conference, not a distribution of the petition itself — the petition has never been conferenced (BIO due Aug 26, 2026, after this snapshot). The baseline band and my relist-increment claim are stated from that count as frozen; if the resolver counts only petition distributions the increment claim is unaffected (a first petition distribution is near-certain either way), but the band may understate the petition's eventual trajectory.

This case (the 9/11 military-commission plea-agreement mandamus litigation) was widely covered through the model's training cutoff, including the D.C. Circuit's July 2025 decision and the January 2026 en banc denial. The cert petition's disposition post-dates the cutoff and the docket confirms it is pending, so no outcome knowledge exists; background familiarity was used only as pre-snapshot public context.
